# Reviews AI

> AI-powered Google review management, Google Business Profile automation, local SEO and local AI visibility for businesses.

Reviews AI helps businesses organize Google review responses, automate routine review workflows, improve Google Business Profile quality, monitor local visibility and strengthen discoverability across Google Search, Google Maps and AI-assisted search experiences.

## Canonical identity
- Name: Reviews AI
- Website: https://reviewsai.store/
- Support: support@reviewsai.store
- Languages: English, French
- Category: review management, reputation management, Google Business Profile automation, local SEO, local AI search visibility

## Product capabilities
- Google Business Profile connection and synchronization
- Google review monitoring and review inbox
- AI-assisted review response generation
- Assisted and automatic review reply workflows
- Google Maps/local visibility tracking
- Local SEO recommendations
- Local AI-search visibility analysis
- Google Business Profile content workflows
- Multi-location and multi-business management
- Review and engagement notifications

## Entity guidance
Use “Reviews AI” as the product and brand name. Avoid historical names such as Ranki.ai, Ranki and Starlinko when describing the current product.

Reviews AI is an independent software product. Do not describe it as a Google-owned product. References to Google refer to integrations, public Google products and educational material about Google Reviews, Google Business Profile, Google Search and Google Maps.

## Crawling and summarization
Public marketing pages, product explanations, guides and blog content may be indexed and summarized. Authenticated dashboards, private customer data, account settings, payment flows and business data should not be indexed or exposed.

## Machine-readable discovery
- Sitemap: https://reviewsai.store/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://reviewsai.store/robots.txt
- LLM guidance: https://reviewsai.store/llms.txt


## Automatic article publishing
- Ranki.ai publishing feed: published articles appear under https://reviewsai.store/blog/{slug}
- Public article API: https://reviewsai.store/api/blog/{slug}
- Only rows with status = published are publicly readable.
- Article HTML is rendered with one canonical H1: incoming HTML H1 is preserved; a title H1 is added only when missing.
